scenarios.title: Eternalize exiles the card as a cost and creates a black 4/4 Zombie token copy with no mana cost
decisions: A activates eternalize {4}{U}{U} of Proven Combatant from the graveyard, tapping all six Islands and exiling Proven Combatant as part of the cost.
B has priority with the ability on the stack and passes; A passes.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Proven Combatant is in exile, not in the graveyard. A token copy of Proven Combatant is created on the battlefield: a black 4/4 Zombie Human Warrior with no mana cost.

variants.label: ability_countered
variants.delta: B responds by casting Stifle with its Island, targeting the eternalize ability.
variants.expected: The eternalize ability is countered. Proven Combatant stays in exile because exiling was a cost, and no token is created. Stifle is in B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Eternalize can be activated only as a sorcery
decisions: A tries to activate eternalize {4}{U}{U} of Proven Combatant from the graveyard, tapping all six Islands.
Both players pass; if the ability was activated, it resolves.

variants.label: main_phase
variants.expected: Activation is legal with an empty stack during A's main phase. After resolution a black 4/4 Zombie Human Warrior token copy of Proven Combatant is on the battlefield and the card is in exile.

variants.label: end_step
variants.delta: It is A's end step instead of the first main phase.
variants.expected: Activation is not legal outside a main phase. Proven Combatant stays in A's graveyard and the Islands stay untapped.
